steps.domain_action: Initialize the unconstrained complex plane as the void state before any partition function definition.
Split the single zero state into two symmetric arms representing the positive and negative field configurations.
Apply the forward morphism of field reversal h to minus h on the positive arm.
Affirm the vacuous nature of the proof on the positive arm, establishing the zero lies on the circle.
Apply the reverse morphism of field reversal minus h to h on the negative arm.
Hold the negative state on the negative arm, enforcing the topological obstruction against deformation.
Engage the paradice state where both the affirmative proof and negative obstruction are held simultaneously.
Compose the forward and reverse morphisms to form the identity map mu composed with delta.
Fuse the two arms back into a single state, reconstituting the zero pinned to the unit circle.
Assert the identity of the fused state, confirming the Frobenius structure where the composition yields the identity.
Record the integer winding number as a permanent, irreversible topological invariant.
Anchor the entire system to the unit circle boundary, closing the phase transition locus.
